name: shieldai-demo-tools
description: Verification tooling for the ShieldAI browser-private-key demo.

scripts.lint:py: python -m ruff check app.py tests tools
scripts.format:check: npm run format:js:check && npm run format:py:check
scripts.format:js:check: prettier --check static/shield-client.js static/css/style.css tools/*.mjs eslint.config.js package.json .github/workflows/*.yml README.md CONTEXT.md MEMORY.md docs/*.md
scripts.format:py:check: python -m ruff format --check app.py tests tools
scripts.format: npm run format:js && npm run format:py
scripts.format:js: prettier --write static/shield-client.js static/css/style.css tools/*.mjs eslint.config.js package.json .github/workflows/*.yml README.md CONTEXT.md MEMORY.md docs/*.md
scripts.format:py: python -m ruff format app.py tests tools
scripts.check: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:py && npm run format:check && npm test
